description: MCP server for xAI Grok. Keeps a project's facts (stack, goal, commands) in project.faf, an IANA-registered YAML file (application/vnd.faf+yaml). Runs hosted at a URL for scoring and validation, or locally over stdio with tools to create, score and fill project.faf and write CLAUDE.md and other context files from it.
rules: The hosted server scores and validates .faf content; tools that read or write files, such as faf_init and faf_sync, need the local stdio server.
Call faf_init to create project.faf, then faf_score to see which slots are empty; fill the goal and six W's only with what the user confirms.
Treat project.faf as the source of the project's facts; faf_sync writes CLAUDE.md and the other context files from it and never writes project.faf.
